title: PEM electrolyzer OER reference family
objective: Optional literature-backed PEM electrolyzer anode family for screening Ir- and Ru-based acidic OER routes with explicit membrane, ionomer, and PTL defaults. These candidates are reference starting points for route maturity, source quality, and current stack cost pressure rather than hard product definitions.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance current stack economics, evidence quality, route maturity, and reported performance.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward lower current electrode-layer cost while preserving route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward stronger literature support and better route reproducibility for PEM anode screening.

route_templates.name: Standard IrOx PEM anode route
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: PFSA-bound PEM anode ink to membrane / PTL route
preprocess: IrOx powder staging and solids check
route_templates.route_note: Closest public-facing proxy to conventional PEMWE anode manufacturing using purchased IrOx powder, PFSA binder, reinforced membrane, and titanium PTL.

route_templates.name: Interface-engineered low-Ir PEM route
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: Low-loading supported or interface-engineered Ir route
synthesis: Support-assisted Ir deposition or reconstruction setup
route_templates.route_note: Support and interface engineering can cut Ir loading sharply, but the route depends on tighter PTL control and less mature reconstruction windows than the standard IrOx baseline.

route_templates.name: Ru-rich acidic OER route
route_templates.route_note: Ru-rich acidic OER routes can relieve noble-metal cost pressure, but stability control and impurity tolerance remain less mature than Ir-dominant PEM anodes.

candidates.title: IrO2 PEM anode baseline
candidates.summary: Conventional IrOx + PFSA + reinforced membrane + titanium PTL route used as the transparent PEMWE baseline.
decision_notes: Most defensible PEM electrolyzer starting point because every layer in the stack is anchored to public catalog data or top-journal route references.
Economics are still dominated by scarce Ir powder and titanium-side hardware, so this route is the right control case rather than the cost winner.

pricing.evidence_label: Fuel Cell Store XT Iridium Oxide Grade S
pricing.note: Public IrO2 powder quote used as a transparent PEM anode procurement anchor.

candidates.title: Low-Ir interface-engineered PEM route
candidates.summary: Support and interface engineering route that targets PEMWE-grade performance while pushing Ir loading toward the 0.1-0.2 mg cm-2 band.
decision_notes: This is the strongest low-Ir screening route now that the family explicitly prices membrane, ionomer, and titanium-side hardware instead of only powder mass.
Route discipline is tighter than the baseline because low-Ir utilization depends on interfacial contact, reconstruction control, and narrow loading windows.

pricing.evidence_label: Fuel Cell Store XT Iridium Oxide Grade S
pricing.note: IrO2 powder retained as the transparent purchased catalyst anchor while literature references justify much lower deployed loading.

candidates.title: Ru-rich acidic OER route
candidates.summary: Ru-rich acidic OER route used to test whether newer stabilization strategies can offset lower catalyst price with acceptable durability risk.
decision_notes: This is the current price-pressure relief route because RuO2 is materially cheaper than IrO2 in the library, and the benchmark now reflects that directly in electrode-layer costing.
Use it as a scenario route, not the default procurement basis, because acidic durability and impurity tolerance still lag the best Ir-focused PEMWE routes.

pricing.evidence_label: Fuel Cell Store XT Ruthenium Oxide Grade S
pricing.note: Public RuO2 powder quote used as the transparent low-cost acidic OER anchor.

candidates.title: IrO2/TiO2 supported anode
candidates.summary: Nanometric iridium oxide dispersed in a titania matrix - the commercial route to lower iridium per square centimeter, with the device-level 1-2 mgIr/cm2 loading window documented.
decision_notes: The middle path between the pure-IrO2 baseline and the exploratory low-Ir entries: proven dilution on a public-priced support.
Adams-fusion synthesis (molten NaNO3) rides the family's standard route with its markup carried on the iridium term.

pricing.note: Live Ir feed with an Adams-fusion precursor markup; ~40 mol% Ir composition is source-quoted.
